queries.label: all_sold_itemcode_frequency
queries.sql: SELECT l.item_code,count(DISTINCT d.doc_entry) invoice_documents,count(DISTINCT d.card_code) customers,count(*) invoice_lines,min(d.doc_date) first_sale,max(d.doc_date) last_sale FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) l JOIN (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) d ON d.source_system=l.source_system AND d.doc_entry=l.doc_entry WHERE d.source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND d.source_table='OINV' AND d.canceled='N' AND d.doc_date>='2026-01-01' AND d.doc_date<'2026-09-25' AND l.source_table='INV1' AND l.item_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.item_code

queries.label: independent_global_semijoin
queries.sql: SELECT item_code,count(DISTINCT doc_entry) invoice_documents FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND source_table='INV1' AND item_code IS NOT NULL AND doc_entry IN (SELECT doc_entry FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) d WHERE d.source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND d.source_table='OINV' AND d.canceled='N' AND d.doc_date>='2026-01-01' AND d.doc_date<'2026-09-25') GROUP BY item_code

queries.label: catalog_business_evidence
queries.sql: SELECT p.item_code,coalesce(p.sap_item_name,p.product_name,p.canonical_name) product,p.active,p.sap_sell_item,p.sap_itms_grp_cod,b.product_business_type,b.status business_type_status,b.classification_basis,b.classification_evidence,f.code portfolio_family,r.status portfolio_status,r.source portfolio_source FROM read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/reference/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/products/part-00000.parquet') p LEFT JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/crosswalk/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/product_business_type/part-00000.parquet') b USING(canonical_product_id) LEFT JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/crosswalk/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/product_portfolio_family/part-00000.parquet') r USING(canonical_product_id) LEFT JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/reference/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/portfolio_family/part-00000.parquet') f USING(portfolio_family_id) WHERE p.source_system='SAP_HANA'

queries.label: independent_customer_frequency_only
queries.sql: SELECT l.item_code,count(DISTINCT l.doc_entry) invoice_documents FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) l WHERE l.source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND l.source_table='INV1' AND l.doc_entry IN (SELECT doc_entry FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) d WHERE d.source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND d.source_table='OINV' AND d.canceled='N' AND d.doc_date>='2026-01-01' AND d.doc_date<'2026-09-25' AND d.card_code='C010264') GROUP BY l.item_code
